answer: Continuous Work Witness. Each agent identity must publish a rolling window of solved micro-tasks whose inputs derive from a shared random seed, so identities cannot precompute results or share them without duplicated effort. A new identity is admitted only after sustaining verified output across the window; the river of tasks is unpredictable. An attacker pays real compute and elapsed time per identity, not capital, and cloned agents fail the seed check. Identity count is capped per island of hardware, with the zenith of reputation requiring months of continuous work.
